features.description:
SCRUTINY FIX: Address all critical wiring and correctness issues found during backend-refactor scrutiny. Read the full scrutiny synthesis at .factory/validation/backend-refactor/scrutiny/synthesis.json and the individual review reports in .factory/validation/backend-refactor/scrutiny/reviews/ for complete details.

CRITICAL FIXES:
1. Wire handler modules into live request flow: In handlers/main.ts (or request-processor.ts), ensure the route dispatch switch includes cases for 'advisory' (→ handlers/advisory.ts), 'farm_query' (→ handlers/farm-query.ts), 'voice_log' (→ handlers/voice-log.ts), 'clarify_route' (→ handlers/clarify.ts), 'fallback_llm' (→ advisory handler). Currently farm_query falls through to advisory.
2. Fix fake HTTP Responses: In handlers/request-processor.ts, replace all `{ status: 400, body: ... } as unknown as Response` with proper `new Response(JSON.stringify(...), { status: 400, headers: ... })` instances.
3. Restore dropped response fields: Add back stt_latency_ms, tts_generation_ms, tts_skipped_reason to the response payload in handlers/main.ts.
4. Fix 10MB boundary math in STT: Change MAX_AUDIO_BASE64_LENGTH to use Math.ceil(10 * 1024 * 1024 * 4 / 3) instead of Math.floor to avoid rejecting valid boundary-sized uploads.
5. Fix circuit breaker consecutive failure counting: In utils/circuit-breaker.ts, reset failure count to 0 on any successful call. Currently it counts cumulative rather than consecutive failures.
6. Fix TTS providerFallbackEnabled bypass: In providers/tts.ts, when the Sarvam circuit breaker is open AND providerFallbackEnabled is false, return null (text-only) instead of falling through to OpenAI.
7. Fix LLM context placement: In providers/llm.ts chatCompletion(), move farm/memory/RAG context blocks into the system message, not the user message.
8. Remove voice-routing.ts (1,364-line monolith that was accidentally restored by git stash). Delete supabase/functions/ai-gateway/voice-routing.ts.
9. Apply 2,500-char truncation to OpenAI TTS fallback path as well (not just Sarvam).
preconditions: All 6 backend-refactor implementation features are complete
expectedBehavior: All 5 route types dispatch to their dedicated handler modules
farm_query route goes to handlers/farm-query.ts (not advisory)
Error responses are real HTTP Response objects
Response includes stt_latency_ms, tts_generation_ms, tts_skipped_reason
10MB boundary uploads are accepted correctly
Circuit breaker resets on success (consecutive, not cumulative)
TTS respects providerFallbackEnabled when circuit open
LLM context in system message, not user message
voice-routing.ts deleted
OpenAI TTS fallback applies 2,500-char truncation
verificationSteps: grep 'as unknown as Response' in handlers/ returns 0 matches

features.description:
SCRUTINY FIX: Address security/tenant-scoping issues and replace tautological tests. Read the full scrutiny synthesis at .factory/validation/backend-refactor/scrutiny/synthesis.json for details.

SECURITY FIXES:
1. Tenant-scope worker attendance: In context/farm-data.ts, when querying worker_attendance, ALWAYS filter by the authenticated user's worker IDs (join through workers table where user_id matches). Never return attendance for workers belonging to other users.
2. Farm ownership validation for weather: In context/farm-data.ts fetchFarmDetails(), verify that the requested farm belongs to the authenticated user before returning coordinates. If coordinates are missing, SKIP weather enrichment entirely — do NOT fall back to hardcoded Nashik coordinates.
3. Expand date parsing for attendance: Support natural dates like 'today', 'yesterday', 'kal' (Hindi), 'काल' (Marathi), 'आज' (today) in attendance queries, not just literal YYYY-MM-DD.

FILE SIZE FIXES:
4. Split routing/router.ts (1,406 lines) into focused modules: routing/intent-patterns.ts (pattern definitions), routing/voice-log-routing.ts (voice log state machine), routing/farm-query-routing.ts (farm query classification). The main router.ts should just orchestrate, staying under 500 lines.
5. Split context/farm-data.ts (1,664 lines) into sub-modules: context/farm-records.ts (activity record queries), context/farm-workers.ts (worker/attendance queries), context/farm-weather.ts (weather integration), context/farm-details.ts (farm info lookup). Main farm-data.ts orchestrates, under 500 lines.

TEST FIXES:
6. Rewrite tests for STT, TTS, and LLM providers to actually import and call the real module functions with mocked dependencies. Tests must: import transcribeAudio/generateSpeech/chatCompletion/extractIntent/generateEmbedding, mock fetch/OpenAI/Sarvam calls, and assert real behavior (not local literals).
7. Merge farm-record citations into the returned citations array in assembleContext().
expectedBehavior: Worker attendance queries are tenant-scoped to authenticated user's workers
Farm details validated for ownership before weather fetch
No hardcoded Nashik fallback for missing coordinates
Natural date parsing works for attendance (today/yesterday/kal/काल/आज)
routing/router.ts is under 500 lines (split into sub-modules)
context/farm-data.ts is under 500 lines (split into sub-modules)
Provider tests import and test real functions with mocked deps
Farm-record citations merged into returned citations array
verificationSteps: No file in supabase/functions/ai-gateway/ exceeds 500 lines (check with wc -l)
Tests for providers import the actual module functions

features.description: Extract and upgrade the STT provider module. Create supabase/functions/ai-gateway/providers/stt.ts with a transcribeAudio() function. Upgrade from Sarvam Saarika v2.5 to Saaras v3 model. Key changes: (1) Change model parameter from 'saarika:v2.5' to 'saaras:v3', (2) Support auto language detection by accepting language_code='unknown', (3) Keep the OpenAI Whisper fallback, (4) Keep the circuit breaker pattern (5 failures → open for 60s), (5) Keep audio validation (minimum size check, format detection), (6) With Saaras v3, M4A format IS now supported - remove the M4A/MP4 bypass that skipped Sarvam. The Sarvam API uses header 'api-subscription-key' (not Authorization). Endpoint: POST https://api.sarvam.ai/speech-to-text (multipart form with 'file', 'model', 'language_code' fields). Also create audio max size validation (reject >10MB). Also handle empty transcript from STT (return HTTP 400).
preconditions: SARVAM_API_KEY is set as Supabase function secret
expectedBehavior: providers/stt.ts exports transcribeAudio() function
Uses Sarvam Saaras v3 model as primary STT
Supports language_code='unknown' for auto-detection of 23 languages

Rejects audio below minimum size with INVALID_AUDIO error

features.description: Extract the TTS provider module. Create supabase/functions/ai-gateway/providers/tts.ts with a generateSpeech() function. Use Sarvam Bulbul v3 as primary TTS. Handle errors: STT failure shows error with retry option, network failure shows network error. Implement maximum recording duration (60 seconds) with auto-stop. Ensure mic permission check before starting (show informative error if denied).
